identity.title: Carrier vs. Licona (2004)
identity.dateBasis: Source publisher identifies this as the UCLA Spring 2004 debate; exact event day is not asserted.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Formal introductions and explicit announced turn transitions identify Mike Licona and Richard Carrier; full source reviewed before the narrower scope was explicitly approved.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: The complete candidate caption track is preserved. Only the expressly authorized complete formal rounds are supplied to assessment workers; all later Q&A is excluded. Caption track metadata is not a guarantee of wording accuracy.

participants.basis: Exactly two substantive advocates within the approved formal-rounds window. This finding does not apply to the excluded Q&A, where moderator-authored premises caused the original whole-recording hold.

formalRoundsScope.scope: The complete formal openings, rebuttals, responses, and final statements only. Introductory material and all later questions, answers, moderator challenges, and closing exchanges are outside assessment. Procedural moderator transitions inside the formal rounds are not scored.
formalRoundsScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: Only the formal debate rounds (5:10–1:38:23) are assessed. These scores are not an assessment of the complete recording.
